author: Ava Davis
title: Abilene Regional Airport reports 9% increase in passenger boardings - NewsBreak
text:
By Ava Davis ,
4 hours ago ABILENE, Texas ( KTAB/KRBC ) — More people are flying out of Abilene as the Abilene Regional Airport continues to see record growth.
Passenger boardings at the airport are up nearly 9% compared to this time last year, following a record-breaking year in 2025.
Passenger numbers soar as Abilene Regional Airport sets new record Airport officials say the increase is being driven by continued business activity and economic growth in Abilene.
“It’s a lot of the business activity that’s going on in the city and around the city,” said Don Green, Director of Transportation Services for the City of Abilene. “There’s just a lot of good things happening.”
Green said the growth is also translating into more leisure travel, with more people choosing to fly in and out of Abilene.
The increase is not only showing up in the terminal, but airport leaders also shared that parking revenue is up 32% compared to this time last year.
“Our largest operating revenue source for the airport is the parking lot, and rental car commissions are our number two source,” Green said. “Both of those are up. So, this is very good. It has allowed us to take care of our operating expenses completely on our own without being a part of the city’s general fund.”
Abilene air travel takes off with new United flights While the growth is positive, Green said accommodating the increased demand has required adjustments.
“It’s a challenge, but it’s a great challenge to have,” Green said.
As more passengers continue using the airport, officials are focused on keeping the travel experience convenient and efficient.
The growth comes as the Abilene City Council recently approved the first phase of a terminal expansion project, which will help the boarding area accommodate the increasing number of passengers.
